string.name: desc
string.value:
#cIncreases total damage# .
Grants an additional chance to cast without consuming throwing stars or MP, and a chance to #crecharge 1 throwing star#.
(Will not generate more than the maximum throwing star limit.)
When Expert Throwing Star Handling is activated, the #cnext attack will always be a Critical Attack#. (Critical is applied for Spirit of the Star, but throwing stars will not be recharged.)
Required Skill: #cSpirit of the Star Lv. 5#
